messages:

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership briefing: flight plan + launch risk thermostat

Team —

Quick leadership readout ahead of the QBR pack. I captured the current roadmap status, hard delivery dates, and a simple "risk thermostat" we can present to execs (Green / Amber / Red). Please treat this as the single source for the Friday leadership run-through and push updates into the attached delta sheet.

Summary (high level)
- Product: Model v2 rollout (beta customers) targeted week of 2027-04-18; full rollout 2027-05-02.
- Platform: Dedicated EU region readiness on 2027-04-25 (soft launch), US Dedicated increase for Acme on 2027-04-20.
- Developer tools: Feature-flag API GA on 2027-04-15.

Risk Thermostat (current):
- Model v2 accuracy regressions: AMBER 
- Dedicated region capacity/ops readiness: AMBER
- Feature-flag GA (stability): RED (known SRE backlog & infra window)

Top asks:
1) Risk owners, update mitigation bullet points in the attached spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow.
2) Confirm freeze date for code that touches the inference runtime (proposal: 2027-04-08).
3) Operations: confirm additional GPU capacity options for Acme peak (see related links).

Attachments: 20270401-roadmap-delta.xls (sheet: risk-ledger)

Jonas
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 14:22:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: flight plan + launch risk thermostat

Appreciate the concise framing. Quick tech rundown and mitigations below (so leadership has concrete options).

Model v2 (accuracy/quality) — AMBER- Risk: small token-level regressions observed on rare prefix combos; KV cache interaction with new attention kernels could surface latency spikes.
- Mitigation: gated canaries on 2 high-volume customers (including Acme); add a token-sampling quality monitor and rollback flag at the model router layer. Proposed canary length: 2 weeks with daily QA scorecard.

Feature-flag GA — RED- Risk: feature-flag middleware currently causes ~5% cold-start latency variance under synthetic load. On SRE-limited ops, this is our biggest risk.
- Mitigation: temporary throttling on non-essential flag checks, pre-warming caches during golden hours, and a fallback route to stable flag implementation if latency > 2.5s p95. Need a staged rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automation to abort.

Dedicated EU region — AMBER- Risk: container image promotion pipeline has one manual approval step that can block rollouts during cross-region holidays.
- Mitigation: automate promotion with a safety hold that requires two approvals but only during business hours; pre-approve overnight images for the soft launch.

Action items from infra/engineers:
- I'll push the model-router rollback flag by 2027-04-05 and own the canary QA dashboard.
- Request: SRE to confirm the 48-hour emergency window Monica mentioned; also need elevated quota for ephemeral GPU instances for two weeks (linked in related links).

Vivek
Head of Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: flight plan + launch risk thermostat

Team — infra update. I ran a capacity model overnight and there are two conflicts we must resolve before we green-light the US Dedicated increase for Acme on 2027-04-20:

1) Scheduled maintenance: Our primary GPU cluster (us-west-2) has a planned firmware upgrade on 2027-04-19 that could reduce capacity by ~18% for a 6-hour window. This overlaps with our proposed provisioning timeline.
2) Quota ceilings: The current quota request for ephemeral GPUs for the Acme canary is still in review with our cloud partner. If the review isn't approved by 2027-04-12 we won't have the headroom for initial canaries.

Mitigations:
- Move the Acme provisioning to 2027-04-21 (preferred) or secure an uplifted quota by 2027-04-12.
- I've attached the gpu-capacity-report-Apr.xlsx with per-cluster detail and a timeline heatmap.
- If we need urgent capacity we can initiate an expedited request with CloudPartner Ops (contact vendor-cloudops@cloudpartner.io); they indicated a 24-48h turnaround on expedited cases but it will require cost approval.

Irene
Director, Infrastructure
